raw_file_import.label: Raw File Import
raw_file_import.description: Import a specific uploaded CSV, Excel, TXT or JSON data file.

normalize_columns.label: Normalize / Column Mapping
normalize_columns.description: Optional column mapping: each key becomes a typed axis and each value must name a real column of the uploaded file. With no mapping the table passes through unchanged, so a loaded Domain Package can apply its own mapping defaults.

type_cast.label: Type Cast
type_cast.description: Abstract pass-through node whose concrete input and output types are selected per node instance.

skill_node.label: AI Skill Node
skill_node.description: Runs a versioned domain skill against typed data and returns a schema-bound artifact.

join.label: Join
join.description: Combine every artifact connected to the multi-input 'items' port into one auditable collection.

aggregate.label: Aggregate
aggregate.description: Summarize the numeric fields that the upstream artifacts share.

quality_report.label: Quality Report
quality_report.description: Evaluate declared expectations about an upstream artifact and report pass or fail; declaring no check fails closed.

x-matflow-ready.description: declare at least one check: required_keys or metric_key

conditional_gate.label: Conditional Gate
conditional_gate.description: Pass an artifact through only while its quality report passes; a failing report stops downstream work. The decision is recorded inside the passed artifact under 'gate' and 'decision'.

eis_basic_qc.label: EIS Basic Analysis
eis_basic_qc.description: Nyquist/Bode quality checks and a typed EIS output. Uses the upstream column mapping keys frequency_column, real_column and imag_column when the Normalize node supplies them; otherwise it falls back to its own parameters of the same names (defaults frequency_hz, z_real, z_imag).

plot_nyquist.label: Plot Nyquist
plot_nyquist.description: Create a standard Nyquist plot from EIS data (uses its real_column and imag_column mapping).

xrd_peak_extraction.label: XRD Peak Extraction
xrd_peak_extraction.description: Extract diffraction peaks from a two-theta and intensity table.

xrd_reference_match.label: XRD Reference Match
xrd_reference_match.description: Match extracted diffraction peak positions against user-supplied reference peak lists.

ftir_peak_extraction.label: FTIR Peak Extraction
ftir_peak_extraction.description: Extract absorption peaks from a wavenumber and absorbance table.

ftir_band_assignment.label: FTIR Band Assignment
ftir_band_assignment.description: Assign extracted infrared peak positions to user-supplied wavenumber ranges.

qe_structure.label: Crystal Structure
qe_structure.description: Validate a crystal cell, atomic coordinates and pseudopotential mapping.

qe_pw_input.label: QE pw.x Input
qe_pw_input.description: Generate a complete Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x input deck from a typed crystal structure and validated SCF/relax parameters.

qe_parse_output.label: QE Result Parser
qe_parse_output.description: Parse final total energy, Fermi energy and convergence evidence from QE output.

qe_replay_stdout.label: Archived QE Output (Demo)
qe_replay_stdout.description: Load a pinned historical QE stdout fixture for the local replay demo.

EISData.name: EISData
EISData.description: Impedance spectra with a retained frequency axis.

EISQCReport.name: EISQCReport
EISQCReport.description: Quality-control findings for one impedance measurement.

XRDPeaks.name: XRDPeaks
XRDPeaks.description: Peak positions and heights extracted from a diffraction signal.

FTIRPeaks.name: FTIRPeaks
FTIRPeaks.description: Peak positions and heights extracted from an infrared signal.

CrystalStructure.name: CrystalStructure
CrystalStructure.description: Cell, species, pseudopotentials and atomic coordinates.

QEInput.name: QEInput
QEInput.description: A validated Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x input deck.

QEStdout.name: QEStdout
QEStdout.description: Quantum ESPRESSO standard output with source provenance.

QEResult.name: QEResult
QEResult.description: Parsed energy, Fermi level and convergence state.

eis.label: Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy
eis.description: EIS measurement types, a basic quality-control analysis, a Nyquist plot Tool and the legacy human-decision gate migration.

xrd.label: X-ray Diffraction
xrd.description: XRD-specific recipe vocabulary and reviewed reference recipes.

ftir.label: Fourier-Transform Infrared Spectroscopy
ftir.description: FTIR-specific recipe vocabulary and reviewed reference assignments.

qe.label: Quantum ESPRESSO
qe.description: Generate pw.x inputs and parse auditable Quantum ESPRESSO results.

qe_demo.label: QE historical replay demo
qe_demo.description: Demo-only archived output source; depends on QE types and parsers.
